analyst_view.overall: Toulouse are 12th with 14 points and drew 1-1 at Lens last Saturday behind a compact defence; a win would lift them above Rennes. Rennes are 9th with 17 points but without a win in four, and Franck Haise is under pressure: reports (433foot, citing But! Football Club) say management has Pierre Sage in mind if results don't improve and that this week's games at NEC Nijmegen and Toulouse could decide his future. Rennes play at Nijmegen in the Europa League tonight at 21:00 without captain Valentin Rongier and Mahdi Camara, so they have under three days and a trip before Sunday's 17:15 kick-off; Rongier, Thomasson (suspended) and Frankowski are already taken off by the numbers. For Toulouse, centre-back Mark McKenzie came off at half-time at Lens with a hamstring problem (one report, no update since), which the numbers don't know. Referee Guillaume Paradis (4.0 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, Toulouse 1.7 and Rennes 1.2, already taking off Thomasson, Rongier and Frankowski (about -17% for Rennes). I lean slightly lower, to about 2.84: Rennes come in tired from a Thursday-night game in the Netherlands and short of confidence, while Toulouse defended well at Lens; I keep it small because McKenzie's hamstring could weaken Toulouse's back line.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, 5.0 for Toulouse and 4.4 for Rennes, already lowering Rennes for their recent counts. Toulouse were happy to sit back at Lens but are at home here, and nothing on lineups or style points either way, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, with referee Paradis (4.0 a game) adding about 4% and Toulouse's busy recent card count adding a little. A Rennes side playing for their coach's job could get edgy if behind, but that is a hunch, so I stay at about 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.5 shots, already lowering Toulouse for their recent output (61 shots in 6). Rennes' fatigue could cut their own shots but give Toulouse more room at home, so the two roughly cancel and I stay at about 25.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target, Toulouse 5.0 and Rennes 3.9, already lowering Rennes because Toulouse have allowed few on target lately (20 in 6). Haise said Rennes struggled to break down Lorient's low block, which the recent figures show, so I stay at about 8.8.
